name: Cheese & Folk Crafts Festival Lienz
beschreibung: The craft festival in Lienz brings together the art of cheesemaking and traditional costume craftsmanship. Cheesemakers from all over Osttirol present their specialties, while costume makers showcase the region's traditional attire. Folk dance performances and a craftsmen's competition complete the programme.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional craft festival with cheese tastings, traditional costume shows, and folk dancing in Lienz.
